slug: 2024-09-17 ST Digital expands into DRC, partners with OADC Texaf Kinshasa (press release)

facts.fact: ST Digital's press release of 2024-09-17 describes the OADC Texaf Kinshasa data centre (2MW) as the DRC's first live open-access, carrier-neutral data centre, hosting national and international carriers and colocating ST Digital; date is the release date as the document gives no opening date.

The document describes the live OADC Texaf - Kinshasa data centre as Uptime Institute Tier-III certified (which Uptime certification type is not stated); date is the release date as no certification date is given.

systems.owner: OADC Texaf (Open Access Data Centres and TEXAF)
